content.title: Emil Schneider Park Playground
content.summary: The playground at Emil Schneider Park was renovated and opened to the public in August 2025 as part of the City's Taking Lasting Care program. The new features include a large shade structure, various slides, climbing elements, sensory panels, tree swings, and improved surfacing, all designed based on community feedback gathered through a survey.
content.body:
![Brightly colored new playground in a neighborhood park ](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=6373 "Brightly colored new playground in a neighborhood park ")

As part of the [City's Taking Lasting Care program](/860), the playground at Emil Schneider Park ([7607 W. 72nd. Pl.](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Wj7wt9FUHME26Ca46)) was renovated in 2025!

## Project Update: The new playground is finished

The new playground was completed and opened to the public in August 2025!

### New playground features

The new playground at Emil Schneider Park features the following elements:

- Large shade structure
- Large spiral and tube slides
- Vertical wall, wavy tree, toad stool, river rock, butterfly and additional climbers
- Sensory wave wall and additional sensory panels, Echo Chamber and Bubble Mirror
- Tree swings
- Playcast nature critters
- Full poured-in-place (PIP) surfacing
- New benches and new trash cans

### Project timeline

- Fall 2024: Speak Up Arvada survey open for community members to provide feedback
- Winter 2024-25: The City’s Parks and Urban Design team, in collaboration with a selected consultant, will review the results of the survey and incorporate that feedback into the final design
- Spring 2025: The Parks and Urban Design team will share the final playground design with the community
- July 2025: Construction will begin on the new playground and is expected to take 2 to 3 weeks to complete

## Community engagement

A survey was open on [Speak Up Arvada](https://speakup.arvadaco.gov/h4755#tab-54810) through Sunday, Oct. 6 to gather feedback from community members about their preferred playground themes and equipment.

The City's Parks and Urban Design team incorporated feedback received from the community to select the playground's theme and equipment.
